title.wall_note: NO WALL THICKNESS CALLED OUT ON SKETCH - 9" ASSUMED FOR EXTERNAL WALLS, 4 1/2" FOR INTERNAL PARTITIONS. COLUMNS NOTED AS 250 x 300 mm.

notes: STAIR IS OPEN TO 'SITOUT + DWG.' ON ITS WEST SIDE - NO WALL THERE
assumptions: No compass or north mark is drawn on the sketch. north_deg = 90 (north up) assumed, keeping the sketch's own paper orientation.
No wall thickness is called out anywhere. 9" assumed for the four external walls and 4 1/2" for all internal partitions. Only the column size (250 x 300 mm) is noted.
The sketch gives no plot boundary - only the building envelope 28'-0" x 36'-0". 'plot' is therefore set equal to the building footprint (28 x 36 = 1008 sqft, matching the written area).

Written clear sizes do not close exactly on the overalls. Across: 13'-7" + 13'-2" + assumed walls = 27'-10 1/2" against 28'-0" (1 1/2" short). Up: 12'-0" + 4'-9" + 5'-2" + 12'-0" + assumed walls = 35'-9 1/2" against 36'-0" (2 1/2" short). Both bedrooms and the master bedroom depth were held exact and the slack was absorbed at the partitions: the NE Bed Room / Sitout clear width becomes 13'-3 1/2", the Common Bath depth 5'-3" and the Attach Bath depth 4'-10 1/2".
The wall between Master Bed Room and Bed Room (north) and the wall between Bed Room (south) and Sitout are the SAME centre-line, x = 14.15, so they line up.
The Kitchen's south wall and the Bed Room (south) north wall are the SAME centre-line, y = 12.5625. Holding that alignment makes the Kitchen clear depth 10'-6" against the written 10'-4" (2" over).
The 'Dining' has no size written on the sketch. Its box is derived from the surrounding wall centre-lines (12'-4 1/2" x 10'-10 1/2").

Room names transcribed with the sketch's own spelling corrected only where the letterform is unambiguous: 'Masten Bed Room' read as 'Master Bed Room', 'Kitcheen' read as 'Kitchen'. Both 'Bed Room' labels are kept identical as written and are told apart by position.
The two 'Bed Room' entries and the two doors D2/D5 are distinguished only by their coordinates, as the sketch adds no suffix.

All window, ventilator and door positions and widths were MEASURED off the sketch against the 28'-0"/36'-0" scale (approx. 43.6 px per foot, identical on both axes), not read from written figures - the sketch dimensions no opening. Values are given to the nearest 0.01 ft as measured; none were centred or rounded to neat numbers.

D1, D2, D3 and D5 measure hard against the adjoining partition or column on the sketch and their 'pos' has been set so the far jamb sits on that partition face. D4 and D6 measure hard against the south end of their walls.

The two small yellow marks with red arrowheads on the west wall, serving the Attach Bath and the Common Bath, are read as ventilators (V1, V2). They scale about 1'-0" long; 1'-6" has been used as the nearest sensible vent width.
The doors are all lettered simply 'D' on the sketch except the attach-bath door, which is lettered 'D1'. Tags D2-D6 are sequence numbers added for reference only.

The 'GATE' is drawn as a double-leaf opening in the south wall with a gate rectangle outside the building. It is listed as one door 3'-8" wide (measured); the external gate rectangle is not modelled as a room because no dimension is given for it.

Stair: the 'up' arrow starts west of the stair and points east, the top and bottom flights have vertical tread lines (climbing along x) and the 3'-0" deep strip against the east wall has treads running square across it. This traces as a half-turn (U) stair: east, turn south on straight winders at the east end, then west. Flight width 3'-0" is written three times on the sketch; the turn strip is written '3'' as well.

Stair tread counts (steps_f1 = 7, steps_f2 = 8, winders = 4) were counted off the sketch. The hand-drawn tread lines are not to a consistent going (they scale between about 7" and 1'-0"), so these counts are approximate; the stair topology (U, up from the left, turning on the right, straight winders) is certain.

No DN arrow is drawn, so show_dn is false. The steps are not numbered, so no start_step is given. The gap between the two flights is left blank rather than marked with an X, but it is a genuine void, so well = true.
The stair's west edge is drawn as a single thin line, not a wall, and the 'up' arrow crosses it. No wall is listed there, leaving the stair mouth open to the Sitout.
There is no wall between the Dining and the Sitout across x = 14.15 to 20.4375 at y = 12.5625; the sketch leaves that span open as the passage from Dining to Sitout/stair.
The top dimension string on the sketch shows only the 28'-0" overall and the left string only the 36'-0" overall. The intermediate ticks in 'dims' are the derived centre-line stations of the grid.
